title: Cross-Repo Review: Why AI Teams Need This Now
excerpt: Qodo's new cross-repo review feature signals a fundamental shift in code quality management for AI-flooded teams. The move away from siloed repository analysis addresses critical gaps in how modern development teams maintain code standards at scale.
post_draft:
How do you catch bugs when your AI code lives across five different repos?

Most teams are still reviewing code one repository at a time—missing the bigger picture entirely.

The problem: siloed code review processes can't keep pace with AI-driven development. You get faster code generation, but your quality gates stay stuck in the past.

What's changing: cross-repo review tools are now letting teams analyze code patterns, dependencies, and security issues across their entire codebase at once. This means catching integration problems before they become production headaches.

Why it matters: as AI generates more code faster, you need visibility that matches that velocity. Single-repo reviews just don't cut it anymore.

Read the full breakdown of why cross-repo review is becoming essential for teams scaling AI development—and how it's reshaping code quality management.
